comments.three: PINNED EXACT — do not add a caret, and do not bump without reading this. postprocessing@6.x, a transitive dependency of @react-three/postprocessing, peer-deps three '>=0.168.0 <0.186.0'. three 0.186 is outside it. The failure mode is not an install error: it surfaces weeks later, on an unrelated `npm update`, as a black canvas or a broken effect composer that looks like application code is at fault.
comments.@types/three: PINNED EXACT to match three. three ships no .d.ts files of its own (verified against the 0.185.1 tarball), so these types are required, and DefinitelyTyped tracks three's version 1:1 — a drifting @types/three against a pinned three is the same class of mismatch described above, but at compile time.
comments.typescript: Held at 5.x deliberately. TypeScript 7 (the Go rewrite) is released, but @react-three/fiber v9 augments the React JSX namespace with every three.js element, and that is not the type machinery to be first to prove out on a new compiler implementation.
comments.engine-chunk: §15 wants three + @react-three/* cached independently of app code. That split comes from the next/dynamic boundary in components/world/WorldMount.tsx, not from bundler config — see the note in next.config.ts.
